question.prompt: A can complete a job alone in 10 days, and B can complete it alone in 15 days. A first works alone for 5 days, and then they work together on the remaining work. How many more days are needed to finish? (Unit: days)

solutions.explanation: After A works for 5 days, \(1-5/10=1/2\) of the job remains. Together they complete \(1/10+1/15=1/6\) of the job each day, so they need another \((1/2)\div(1/6)=3\) days.
solutions.title: Remaining work and joint rate
